compose_variable_semantics.source: Typel et al., CompOSE Reference Manual v3.01 (2022), arXiv:2203.03209; cross-checked against repo implementation python_frontend/compose_eos/eos_data.py:94-118 and fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_types.f90:118-143 and docs/NS_COWLING_PHYSICS_AND_CODE_GUIDE_V4.md:25
compose_variable_semantics.units: n_B [fm^-3], P, eps, F per volume [MeV fm^-3], m_n c^2, m_p c^2, mu [MeV], Q1 [MeV], Q2..Q7 dimensionless
compose_variable_semantics.Q2: entropy per baryon (must be 0 for cold T=0)
compose_variable_semantics.Q3: mu_B / m_n - 1 for Il=1 (barotropic enthalpy derivative gauge); for Il=0 Q3 stores mu_B/m_n - 1 - Yq*Q4 (charge-shifted)
compose_variable_semantics.Q4: mu_Q / m_n  (charge chemical potential, mu_Q = mu_p - mu_n)
compose_variable_semantics.Q5: mu_lepton / m_n  (per-CompOSE the included lepton potential)
compose_variable_semantics.Q6: F / m_n - 1  (free energy per baryon, includes rest mass)
compose_variable_semantics.Q7: eps / (n_B m_n) - 1  (energy density per baryon, includes rest mass)
compose_variable_semantics.Il: lepton-content flag; all 18 sources in this cohort are Il=1, Yq=0
compose_variable_semantics.cold_identity: T=0, beta-equilibrium, no trapped leptons => Q2=0, Q5=0 (for Il=1), Q6=Q7, mu_B = F + P/n_B

observed_in_cohort.Q6_minus_Q7: 0 for all 18 models (exact in stored precision)
observed_in_cohort.Q5: APR/BBB/GM/GPPVA/SPG = 0; RG_SLY4=1.383e-3, RG_KDE0v1=6.035e-4 constant => beta_equilibrated=False (this is the true cause of the 156 M7 rejections, NOT a mass issue)

mass_conventions_observed.consequence: Every crust-core pair in the 65-pair matrix carries a different rest-mass convention between crust and core; dmcr ranges from +0.56533 (GPPVA 939 family) to +1.56533 MeV (TM1e).

gauge_alignment_derivation.name: crust->core uniform rest-mass gauge alignment (representation-only)
definition: mu_B,tgt(n) = mu_B,src(n) + dmcr    [follows from mu_B = F + P/n_B]
eps_tgt(n) = eps_src(n) + n * dmcr  [Q7 derived from shifted Q6]
mu_Q,tgt = mu_Q,src                  [gauge INVARIANT: a uniform shift of both m_n and m_p cancels in mu_n - mu_p; the code rescales Q4_tgt = Q4_src * m_src/m_tgt which exactly preserves mu_Q]
gauge_alignment_derivation.what_it_is: A change of the rest-mass GAUGE in which the crust barotrope is tabulated. It re-expresses the SAME physical crust model in the core's neutron-mass gauge.
gauge_alignment_derivation.what_it_is_NOT: It is NOT a physical rest-energy correction. It does not convert a uniform-mass RMF convention into the physical (m_n, m_p) split convention. That conversion requires species-resolved composition (delta eps = delta m_n n_n + delta m_p n_p + binding convention terms) and is BLOCKED for all 13 crusts (no per-nucleus eos.composition; see B2).
invariants_preserved: dF/dln(n_B) = P/n_B exactly (shift is additive in F)

mu_B = F + P/n_B identity exactly on retained crust rows (output Q3 is RE-DERIVED as (F+Q1)/m_n, which also repairs the provider's Euler residual: max 8.2e-2 MeV for GPPVA_DD2, 8.5e-2 DDME2, 3.1e-3 TM1e, 1.3e-3 SPG)
thermodynamic stability and cs2 source values (shift cancels in dP/deps to machine precision: dP unchanged, d(eps+n dmcr)/dn = deps/dn + dmcr, and mu = F+P/n shifts consistently)
inverse_transformation: exact (floating-point) round trip; verified by regression test
gauge_alignment_derivation.residual_cost: The matched output is a THERMO-ONLY barotrope. Its crust-side mu_Q is in the crust provider's uniform convention (missing the physical 1.29333 MeV n-p splitting) while the header records the core's physical (m_n, m_p). This is a documented representation limitation, NOT a thermodynamic inconsistency; the output must not be used for charge-composition physics.
forbidden_cases: composition-bearing inputs WITHOUT drop_composition=true: rejected (existing gate at compose_eos_matching.f90:602-604)
physical split-mass correction without per-nucleus composition: NOT IMPLEMENTED, must remain BLOCKED (B2)
Maxwell pairwise construction across differing (m_n,m_p): rejected by the 1e-12 exact gate at compose_eos_phase_transition.f90:663-665; this gate is PRESERVED unchanged

fortran: compose_eos_matching.f90: expose dmcr and the max source Euler residual in the match report (new report fields dm_mass_gauge_meV and source_euler_residual_meV; additive, no behavior change to the six bridge methods)
compose_eos_phase_transition.f90: NO change to the 1e-12 pairwise mass gate (preserved verbatim)
python: api.py match_core: surface dm_mass_gauge_meV and source_euler_residual_meV from the native payload into info dict

acceptance.maxwell_mass_gate: PRESERVED verbatim (1e-12 relative, neutron and proton checked independently)
acceptance.gate_weakening: NONE (no tolerance was widened to make any pair pass)
